checks.details: Correct fixture passed, injected fault failed simulation, repaired fixture passed.

limitations: Development simulation is not official benchmark correctness; official evaluation has not occurred.
Referenced state diagram was absent; timing interpretation is grounded in supplied prose.
No pre-reset physical initialization behavior is specified or claimed; synchronous reset establishes A.
No synthesis or board work performed.
implementation: Four control states A/B/C/D, two-bit unsigned sample count, and registered one-cycle z. Entry edge excludes w; successive windows have no gaps. Original ports and synchronous active-high reset preserved.
verification: Independent integer window oracle. All eight patterns and all 64 adjacent pattern pairs, entry-edge exclusion, active-state s independence, output stability between rising edges, reset during idle and each partial/completed window phase, and a 600-cycle deterministic stream.
